decisions.reason: Walks the per-keystroke chain: getSnapshot succeeds, current removed, id undefined, null every keystroke, onKeyDown exits before preventDefault; explains guard passes (four member probes survive, only a field gone) and the designed null/no-op silence; no claim the service or guard was removed or throws.

Compares alpha.1 SessionListState vs alpha.2 SessionListSnapshot, quotes navigation-belongs-to-view-owners; maps uiSession.adapter.current ObservableSnapshot<SessionBindingValue> with {key, ctx, hooks, keyedHooks, props}, key replacing current and ctx replacing sessions.scope(id).

One-build resolver feature-detects uiSession and falls back to legacy current + scope(id); inject gains uiSession with alpha.1 tolerance discussed; conversation resolves through binding-value ctx and input.for receives that scope; explicitly states inject alone is not a fix.

Names shape/field-level removal behind container presence and the once-at-activation vs per-use gap; hardened guard probes actual snapshot fields ('current' in snap, key/ctx in binding) and mandates re-probing at effect time on first published snapshot.

Dual-host smoke including key===undefined absent case, branch instrumentation, tsc against both alpha.1 and alpha.2 published types as the strongest gate, negative guard simulation; prevention proposes throwing deprecated getter or validated snapshot-schema contract.
